purpose: Promote verified non-Mundarica source manifestations from discovery to exact-locator source evidence while preserving rights, access, consent, community-validation and cultural-access boundaries.

records.verification_state: provider dataset card and exact Mundari repository path verified; gated bytes, independent hash, exact row count and row-level content not independently verified

not_promoted: participant consent inference beyond provider statement

governance_rule: Public visibility, repository licensing, provider consent statements or technical access do not by themselves establish MLHKP participant consent, privacy clearance, community validation or cultural-access authorization. Cultural access overrides entitlement.
counting_rule: These locator records improve manifestation resolution but do not alter controlled MMSC source counts until deterministic WEB-MUN numbered-register reconciliation assigns canonical identities.
